name: Gravy
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Pour off liquid in pan in which turkey has been roasted.
From liquid skim off six tablespoons fat and return fat to pan.
Pour on gradually three cups stock in which giblets, neck, and tips of wings have been cooked, or use liquor left in pan.
Cook five minutes and season with salt and pepper.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pour off liquid in pan in which turkey has been roasted.
2. From liquid skim off six tablespoons fat and return fat to pan.
3. Brown with six tablespoons flour.
4. Pour on gradually three cups stock in which giblets, neck, and tips of wings have been cooked, or use liquor left in pan.
5. Cook five minutes and season with salt and pepper.
6. Strain.
